Info

Defines structural protocol ISpatialKinematicsSolver for 3D and 4-DOF SCARA calculations.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.solver.analytical.spatial.isolver.ISpatialKinematicsSolver(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining spatial 3D and 4-DOF forward and inverse kinematics.

It defines:

methods:
solve_fk_3d - Computes 3D Cartesian position from joint angles and Z height.
solve_ik_3d - Solves analytical inverse kinematics for 3D coordinate point.
solve_fk_4d - Computes 4-DOF Cartesian pose from joint coordinates.
solve_ik_4d - Solves 4-DOF inverse kinematics from Cartesian pose.
get_version - Returns solver component version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns solver component version string representation.

Returns:

Semantic version string.

solve_fk_3d(theta1: float, theta2: float, z: float) → Point3D[source]¶

Computes 3D Cartesian position from joint angles and Z height via forward kinematics.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

  • z – Linear vertical position in mm.

Returns:

Point3D Cartesian coordinate instance in mm.

solve_fk_4d(theta1: float, theta2: float, z: float, theta4: float) → CartesianPose[source]¶

Computes 4-DOF Cartesian pose from joint coordinates via forward kinematics.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

  • z – Linear vertical position in mm.

  • theta4 – Joint 4 (wrist) angle in radians.

Returns:

CartesianPose instance in mm and radians.

solve_ik_3d(point: Point3D, elbow_left: bool = False) → ScaraJoints3D[source]¶

Solves analytical inverse kinematics for 3D coordinate point with vertical limit check.

Parameters:

  • point – Target Point3D Cartesian coordinate in mm.

  • elbow_left – True for elbow-left configuration, False for right.

Returns:

ScaraJoints3D instance containing joint coordinates, reachability and status.

solve_ik_4d(pose: CartesianPose, elbow_left: bool = False) → ScaraJoints[source]¶

Solves analytical inverse kinematics for 4-DOF Cartesian pose with vertical limit check.

Parameters:

  • pose – Target CartesianPose instance in mm and radians.

  • elbow_left – True for elbow-left configuration, False for right.

Returns:

ScaraJoints instance containing joint configuration, reachability and status.
